CREATE TABLE pv_meta ( ts DateTime64(3), host String, k String, v String ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (ts, host)

), meta AS ( SELECT host, argMax(v, ts) AS v FROM pv_meta WHERE ts <= {ts:DateTime64(3)} AND ts > {ts:DateTime64(3)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND k = 'owner' GROUP BY host ), gone AS ( SELECT host FROM pv_events WHERE ts <= {ts:DateTime64(3)} AND ts > {ts:DateTime64(3)} - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY host HAVING max(ts) < {ts:DateTime64(3)} - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ) SELECT {ts:DateTime64(3)} AS ts, l.host AS host, l.cluster AS cluster, multiIf(l.status = 'down', 'DOWN', l.host IN (SELECT host FROM gone), 'GONE', coalesce(m.v, '') = '', 'UNOWNED', 'OK') AS state, multiIf(l.a00 < 0, 0, m.v =
